definitions.explanation: A member of the armed forces, especially an ordinary enlisted soldier. Can refer to one soldier or, collectively, to troops.

examples.japanese: {兵隊|へいたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{兵隊|へいたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A large number of soldiers marched through the town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧{兵隊|へいたい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather went to war as a soldier when he was young.

notes:
An everyday word for a soldier, particularly a rank-and-file enlisted man. It can name an individual or, used collectively, a body of troops. It carries a slightly old-fashioned, wartime flavor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {兵隊|へいたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a soldier
- {兵隊|へいたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go off to military service

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軍人|ぐんじん}→軍人：02994_gunjin⟧: military serviceman — more formal; includes officers
- ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧: soldier — neutral, standard term, common in news and writing
- {自衛隊員|じえいたいいん}: member of the Self-Defense Forces — the modern term for Japan's forces
